headline: IT Support Specialist
summary: IT support specialist with a year of full-time experience looking after 70 users at a trading and logistics company in Marawi. I troubleshoot hardware and Microsoft Office problems, keep the office network and firewall running, and run short security-awareness sessions for staff. I am certified in networking and working toward a systems role.
skills: Technical support for Windows laptops, desktops and printers
Help desk ticket handling and follow-up
Network administration: switches, VLANs, DHCP, Wi-Fi
Firewall rules and VPN setup on a FortiGate appliance
Clear English, Filipino and Maranao communication

experience.title: IT Support Specialist
bullets: Resolve about 25 help desk tickets a week, most within the same working day.
Configured the office firewall and a VPN so the warehouse in Malabang can reach the inventory system.
Wrote the company's first support request process, with priority levels and a simple ticket form.
Ran quarterly phishing-awareness sessions; reported suspicious emails rose from almost none to about a dozen a month.

experience.title: IT Intern (OJT)
bullets: Re-imaged 60 laboratory computers and labelled and documented every network drop in the building.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
